title: CoPE-CGL: Community-aware Prototype Extraction for Replay-Free Continual Graph Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.35313v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual graph learning (CGL) maintains models as graphs evolve without retraining from scratch, while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods typically target either transductive or inductive settings and often store past subgraphs or require task identifiers at inference. We propose Community-aware Prototype Extraction for Continual Graph Learning (CoPE-CGL), a replay-free framework that uses a parameter-free structural prior, precomputed by multi-hop Laplacian smoothing, to anchor learning, memory, and inference. CoPE-CGL combines topology-infused bottleneck adaptation, community-level prototypes, and dynamic routing by majority vote over node-to-prototype matches. The default protocol assumes each test graph comes from one learned task; a node-level variant handles mixed-task graphs. translated_abstract: 持续图学习（CGL）旨在图数据不断演化的情况下维护模型而无需从头重新训练，同时缓解灾难性遗忘。现有方法通常仅针对直推式或归纳式设置，且往往需要存储过去的子图，或在推理时依赖任务标识符。我们提出了面向持续图学习的社区感知原型提取方法CoPE-CGL，这是一个无重放框架，利用通过多跳拉普拉斯平滑预计算得到的无参数结构先验来锚定学习、记忆和推理过程。CoPE-CGL融合了拓扑增强的瓶颈适配、社区级原型，以及通过对节点到原型匹配进行多数投票实现的动态路由。默认协议假设每个测试图来自一个已学习的任务；节点级变体则可处理混合任务的图。每个任务最多增加恒定量的存储开销，且不保留任何历史图数据。在相同存储条件下且无需任务标识符时，CoPE
tldr: 提出了无重放持续图学习框架CoPE-CGL，利用多跳拉普拉斯平滑预计算的无参数结构先验，结合拓扑增强瓶颈适配、社区级原型和多数投票动态路由，在不存储历史图数据且无需任务标识符的情况下有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: Proposes CoPE-CGL, a replay-free continual graph learning framework that leverages a parameter-free structural prior precomputed via multi-hop Laplacian smoothing, combining topology-infused bottleneck adaptation, community-level prototypes, and majority-vote dynamic routing to mitigate catastrophic forgetting without storing past graph data or requiring task identifiers.
